Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 51: the slip of [[Red Squadron 7 (V)|Red Squadron 7 (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Heroic. May add 1 pilot. Once per game may place a non-[Immune to Alter] Effect at same system in owner's Used Pile. Corran Horn and Keir Santage deploy -1 aboard; if either piloting, immune to attrition < 4.”), word for word the text of [[Red Squadron 7 (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
